Northbank Tool Library: Annual Report, Year One (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026)

About us
Northbank Tool Library opened on 1 March 2025 in a shed behind the Northbank community hall. Membership is free.

The year in numbers
At 28 February 2026 the library had 214 members and 380 tools on the shelves. Almost all of the tools were donated by local households and two hardware stores.
Members borrowed 1,146 times during the year. Nine tools were never returned; the committee wrote them off in February 2026.

Funding
A $3,200 grant from Northbank Council covered public liability insurance and the booking software for the first year.

From the volunteer coordinator
"We've had more drills borrowed than any other tool, by a long way. Ladders came second, and the pressure washer has a waiting list," said Sam Okafor, volunteer coordinator.

Next year
The committee plans to open on Wednesday evenings as well as Saturday mornings from March 2026.
